name: Breadcrumb
description: A navigation trail of links to parent pages of the current page in hierarchical order, helping users understand their location within a website.

roles.description: The breadcrumb trail is contained within a navigation landmark

required_attributes.description: Set to 'page' to identify the current page link

notes: Use <nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'> wrapping an <ol>. The order is meaningful, so it is an ordered list, not a <ul>.
aria-current='page' goes on the LAST crumb — the current page.
The last crumb is usually not a link at all: it points at the page you are already on. Plain text, or an <a aria-current='page'> if your design needs the styling.
Separators (/ or >) must be CSS-generated or aria-hidden. A literal '/' between links is announced as 'slash' on every crumb.
Do not use aria-current='page' on more than one element per page.

raweb_criteria.reason: A breadcrumb is an ordered list and must be marked up as one — <ol>, so the sequence and count are announced.
Each crumb link must be explicit about where it leads.
Each crumb link needs an accessible name.
aria-current='page' must be exposed on the final crumb.
